newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Tuesday beheaded a Saudi man for murder, raising to 59 the number of executions this year in the kingdom, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried on state-run Saudi television said the man was executed after being found guilty of shooting another citizen to death.
It said the man was beheaded in Abha in the southwestern Asir province.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
